title: Environment collection II: rooms, roofs and old trees
releaseContext: Additive art release on the published 5.18 campaign. The stable v19 collection and asset suffix is independent of the application release number.

referenceConventions.files: All file paths are relative to the repository root.
referenceConventions.jsonPointer: References into provenance and audit records use RFC 6901 JSON Pointers.
referenceConventions.rectangles: crop, opaque and parts rectangles are source-pixel [x,y,width,height]. Source PNG and delivery WebP dimensions match.
referenceConventions.anchors: anchor and windowAnchor are absolute source-pixel coordinates. Interior anchors are the crop bottom center; canopy anchors are measured roots; facade windowAnchor registers the existing window center.
referenceConventions.canopyParts: Draw the listed disjoint parts, using their original source offsets and measured root. Do not draw the full rectangular envelope for low-juniper or split-birch.

sourcePolicy: The six built-in ImageGen originals remain unchanged in source-v19. This index references the complete original prompts, generation output history and crop audits in their existing provenance records.

combinedCollections.stagedReason: The two v17 props remain reserved for authored placement; they are not enabled by this collection.

interiorWalls.constraints: Cached wall-only placement preserves actual windows, doorways, hearths, specialist fixtures, irregular floors and chapel walls. Missing images retain existing walls.

architecture.constraints: Aspect-preserving complete crops fit actual wall and roof geometry; true doors, window centers, building silhouettes and occupied roof cells are retained.

canopies.constraints: Existing root registration and visible-tree cohort are preserved. Wind-pruned variants retain direction; other forms may reflect about their root. Missing artwork retains the existing tree fallback.

families.label: Home walls
families.placement: Cached north back-wall details in home and domestic room families.

families.label: Workshop walls
families.placement: Cached north back-wall details in workshop and instrument room families.

families.label: Civic walls
families.placement: Cached north back-wall details in clinic, archive and other civic room families.

families.label: Building bays
families.placement: Complete measured bays fitted to existing window centers and actual exposed wall runs.
families.compatibilityFallback: Existing simplified facade renderer; no new bay drawings in this path.

families.label: Roof and wall craft
families.placement: Existing occupied roof cells, gables and clear wall posts.
families.compatibilityFallback: Existing simplified facade renderer; no new roofcraft drawings in this path.

families.label: Canopy variations
families.placement: Deterministic variants at existing visible tree roots; root sites and visible density are unchanged.

worldCoverage.scope: Potential placements over the complete prepared world before camera culling and scene visibility; these are not simultaneous on-screen counts.
worldCoverage.receiptLifecycle: The linked world receipt is regenerated at release freeze. Placement values here are copied from its art checkpoint and are checked against that receipt; final revision and release verification remain authoritative in the linked records.

nextPriorities: Author real river-landing geometry and a traversable elevation transition before activating staged stairs.
Extend remaining room partitions and corners while preserving actual doorway and fixture clearances.
Develop truthful mechanism states after their integrated state IDs, transitions and saves are stable.
continuation.remainingScope: Whole building facades and an authored river landing are not delivered by this collection. Ground, grass and audio research remain separate workstreams; see the briefs and reconciliation note.

verification.scope: Manifest/file/registry validation only; gameplay, rendering and final release results remain in their linked receipts.

alphaComparison.method: Read-only Pillow decode of all six PNG/WebP pairs; ImageChops difference of every decoded alpha byte.
alphaComparison.filesBoundBy: Per-sheet source and delivery SHA-256 values in this manifest.
